name: esporte-fai
description: Esporte fai desktop app for YouTube audio and video downloads.

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 ESPORTE_FAI_API_URL=https://e.duk4rt.com electron ."
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:electron && npm run build:server && concurrently -k "cross-env PORT=3001 ESPORTE_FAI_DB_PATH=.dev-data/server.sqlite node dist-web-server/server/main.js" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 ESPORTE_FAI_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:electron && npm run build:server
